text:
alexa-fin: Reconciliation alerted: 12 invoices created 2025-03-21 without matching Stripe charges. IDs look like phinv-0321-1..12. Total ~ $4.2k. Marked BLOCKED.

omar-eng: checking webhook consumer and billing-batch. quick grep shows consumer created them with source=stripe_event around 03:40 UTC.

rachel-ops: edge proxy logs show a spike of 502s at 03:39-03:41 UTC. Looks like several deliveries were retried.

stripe-bot: Stripe: event evt_5Gzxy failed delivery attempts 2 and 3 (502/504) but eventually delivered.

omar-eng: root cause: our consumer's idempotency check uses header X-Idemp-Key. The proxy strips headers over 128 chars; our UUID v4 idempotency keys are getting truncated sometimes and treated as missing. When missing, consumer falls back to generating a new invoice instead of deduping.

ben-acct: we must not have invoices without charges. Can we block creation when charge lookup fails?

omar-eng: yes. Plan: 1) hotfix consumer to use event.id fallback and explicit charge existence check before creating invoice; 2) add guard in billing pipeline: EVENTS_WITHOUT_CHARGE -> REVIEW queue.

rachel-ops: deploying hotfix to canary now (image webhook-consumer:2.3.0-fix).

cicd: Deployment started: webhook-consumer -> 2.3.0-fix by omar-eng
cicd: Deployment succeeded at 03:58 UTC

omar-eng: dry-run cleanup: `scripts/find_orphans --date 2025-03-21` output:
Found 12 candidates
 - 2 relinkable after metadata lookup
 - 10 have no matching charge, created during proxy 502 window
Total exposure $4,215.00

pat-cfo: approved to remove orphan invoices for this incident. Keep audit trail.

omar-eng: running cleanup with audit: `scripts/cleanup_orphans --date 2025-03-21 --delete --audit=/var/log/audit/phantom-20250321.log`

[~6m]

omar-eng: cleanup finished: 10 deleted, 2 relinked. Audit log: /var/log/audit/phantom-20250321.log. Reconciliation green for that date.

alexa-fin: please open infra ticket to prevent header truncation and add a test. Also add a check in EOM runbook to scan for orphan invoices.

omar-eng: INFRA-3299 created for header passthrough + tests. PR: https://github.com/redwood/integration/pull/4689 (consumer fallback + charge guard).

alexa-fin: action items: omar-eng deploy & PR (done), rachel-ops infra ticket (INFRA-3299), ben-acct confirm ledger (in progress). Monitoring for 48h. Closing for now.
